mapper.select: SELECT b.`id`, b.`multiple_video_collect_id`, b.`user_id`, b.`device_id`, b.`sort`, b.`tenant`, b.`deleted`, b.`create_by`, b.`creator_id`, b.`creator_type`, b.`create_time`, b.`update_by`, b.`updater_id`, b.`updater_type`, b.`update_time` FROM `multiple_video_collect_camera` b INNER JOIN `security_device_auth` a ON a.`security_device_id` = b.`device_id` INNER JOIN `multiple_video_collect` c ON b.`multiple_video_collect_id` = c.`id` where a.`user_id`=#{userId} AND c.`user_id` = #{userId} and b.`multiple_video_collect_id` = #{multipleVideoCollectId}

SELECT b.`id`, b.`multiple_video_collect_id`, b.`user_id`, b.`device_id`, b.`sort`, b.`tenant`, b.`deleted`, b.`create_by`, b.`creator_id`, b.`creator_type`, b.`create_time`, b.`update_by`, b.`updater_id`, b.`updater_type`, b.`update_time` FROM `multiple_video_collect_camera` b INNER JOIN `security_device_auth` a ON a.`security_device_id` = b.`device_id` where a.`user_id`=#{userId} AND b.`user_id` = #{userId} and b.`source` = #{source}
